points.en: grey-brown upperparts and pale orange-buff underparts (female)

art.subject: Common Redstart (Phoenicurus phoenicurus), adult male in spring: white forehead extending back as a short white line above the eye; crown, nape and back blue-grey; face and throat black; breast and flanks bright orange-red, fading to whitish on the belly and undertail; wings plain grey-brown with no white patch; rump and tail rufous-orange, the central tail feathers dark brown. Thin black bill; dark eye; black legs.
art.pose: perched on a low branch at a woodland edge, side view, rufous tail quivering
art.scene: Korean woodland edge in May with fresh green leaves and dappled light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male breeding, side view perched on a low branch: white forehead, slate-grey crown, nape and back, black face and throat, orange-red breast and flanks fading to whitish on the belly, plain grey-brown wings without a white patch, orange rump, orange-red tail with dark brown central feathers, black bill and legs

adult female, side view perched: grey-brown upperparts, no black on the face, whitish throat, pale orange-buff breast and flanks, pale belly, plain grey-brown wings, orange-red tail with dark brown central feathers, black legs
art.build: Slim chat, about the size of a sparrow but slimmer and longer-legged; rounded head and upright stance. Bill thin, straight and pointed, much shorter than the head. Legs slender, black. Wings fairly long and pointed. Tail of medium length, square-ended, constantly quivered. Female plain grey-brown above with a pale eye-ring, a buff-orange wash below and the same rufous tail.
avoid: Do not add a white wing patch or a black back; those mark the Daurian Redstart (Phoenicurus auroreus), the common redstart in Korea.
Do not extend the black onto the breast; only the face and throat are black (a black breast marks the Black Redstart).
Do not omit the white forehead.
Do not paint the whole tail orange; the central feathers are dark brown.
